About

Give Me a Challenge

My goal is to work in strategy on an international level — specifically helping businesses enter new markets, navigate different cultures, and find their footing in places they've never operated before. That's the kind of work that genuinely excites me.

But to get there, I need to be challenged. I need problems that make me think, situations I haven't seen before, and people willing to push back on my ideas. The only way to know if your thinking is actually valuable is to test it on real businesses with real stakes.

From tracking international audience behavior at NBCUniversal across Brazil, Colombia, and Mexico, to building financial models for nonprofits and advising on strategy at USC Marshall — I've been collecting experiences that point in one direction. Now I want to put them to work for you.

What I Bring

Here's What I Was Taught

These are the areas USC Marshall trained me in. I'm not claiming to be an expert — but I know enough to be useful, and I'm confident enough to be challenged. If any of these sound like something your business needs, let's talk.

Strategy & Operations
✦

Strategic Management

Competitive analysis, business positioning, and long-term planning. Taught to think about where a business is, where it should go, and how to get there. — BUAD 497

◎

Operations Management

How businesses run day-to-day — processes, efficiency, and making sure things actually work. — BUAD 311

◈

Organizational Behavior & Leadership

How teams work, how leaders lead, and how to build a culture that actually performs. — BUAD 304

Finance & Accounting
◑

Financial Analysis

Reading financial statements, understanding what the numbers say about a business, and making decisions based on data. — BUAD 280, 281, 306

❋

Corporate Finance & Financial Modeling

Valuation, forecasting, and building financial models — how businesses think about money at a bigger scale. — Corporate Finance, Financial Modeling

◻

Data Analysis for Decisions

Using statistics and data to back up business decisions rather than just going off gut feel. — BUAD 310/312, BUAD 425

Marketing & Communication
▷

Marketing Strategy

Market research, customer segmentation, positioning, and building campaigns that actually reach people. — BUAD 307

Communication Strategy

The Deal

My Offer to You

Simple deal — you give me the opportunity, I give you 3 free deliverables and everything I've got. All I ask for in return is your honest feedback.

What I actually want in return

Honest feedback. That's it. I want to know if my work was actually useful — or if it wasn't. I want to know what I missed, what could've been better, and whether what I learned at USC Marshall translates into something real. You don't owe me anything except your honest opinion. That feedback is worth more to me right now than money.

Pick up to 3 from the options below

Analysis & Strategy

A Business or Market Analysis

A structured look at your business, your market, or a specific problem — with clear takeaways and recommendations you can actually act on.

Written Content

A Report or Written Piece

A short report, strategy memo, or written content for your brand — researched, organized, and polished.

Design

A Flyer or Banner

A clean, professional graphic for social media, an event, or any promotion you need to get out into the world.

Presentation

A Slide Deck

A presentation deck for a pitch, a proposal, or an internal meeting — structured to communicate your ideas clearly and look great doing it.

Ready? Reach out, tell me about your business, and we'll get on a call to figure out which 3 deliverables make the most sense. No contracts, no pressure — just good work and honest feedback from both sides.
